data.name: Everything_Description
data.value: Use Everything (a high-performance local file search engine) to search for files on your computer.

data.name: Everything_SearchFiles_Description
data.value: Search files using Everything search engine.

data.name: Everything_ExecutablePath_Description
data.value: Optional absolute path to Everything.exe. Used only when the requested instance is not running. Leave empty to find an installed copy. Changes apply to the next query.

data.name: Everything_InstanceName_Description
data.value: Optional exact instance name. Leave empty to use the default Everything 1.4 instance or the 1.5a instance. Changes apply to the next query.
